title: Narendranath is born
summary: VivekMarg opens its life timeline with Narendranath Datta's birth in Calcutta and his early search for truth.

title: The boy who tested a ghost story
summary: A childhood story becomes an early glimpse of his curiosity and willingness to question what he was told.

title: The Raipur years
summary: A family move to Raipur interrupted regular schooling and brought a different kind of learning through conversations with his father.

title: Entrance examination and Presidency College
summary: The timeline marks his entrance examination and the beginning of his college years.

title: The honest sceptic
summary: His search for conviction continues through questions rather than accepting belief without examination.

title: “Have you seen God?”
summary: VivekMarg highlights the question Narendranath brought to spiritual teachers as he sought direct experience.

title: He tests his own teacher
summary: The timeline describes a period of close questioning and testing in his relationship with Ramakrishna.

title: His father dies, and the family faces hardship
summary: After his father's death, the family faced debt and financial difficulty while Narendranath searched for work.

title: Nursing a dying teacher
summary: The timeline records Narendranath's care for Ramakrishna during his final illness.

title: Ramakrishna passes; the fire at Antpur
summary: Ramakrishna's death and a formative gathering at Antpur precede a new chapter for his disciples.

title: Formal vows of sannyasa
summary: The timeline marks the formal renunciation that preceded his public life as a monk.

title: The wandering begins
summary: He begins an extended period of travel across India as a wandering monk.

title: Leaving for good
summary: The timeline marks his departure from the monastery to continue travelling across the country.

title: Alwar and Khetri
summary: Visits to Alwar and Khetri become part of his continuing travels and encounters across India.

title: The rock at Kanyakumari
summary: The timeline highlights his time at Kanyakumari before his journey to the West.

title: Chicago
summary: His journey to Chicago brings his message to the Parliament of the World's Religions.

title: Famous, exhausted, and writing home
summary: The timeline pairs growing public attention in the United States with the strain of travel and his letters home.

title: Thousand Island Park
summary: He teaches a close group of students during a retreat at Thousand Island Park.

title: Turning down the chair
summary: The timeline records a decision to decline an academic position and continue his work.

title: Home, and the work begins
summary: Returning to India, he begins organizing the work that would develop into the Ramakrishna Mission.

title: Plague relief, a school, and a monastery
summary: The timeline connects service during plague relief with educational work and the growing monastery at Belur.

title: Working while ill
summary: He continues teaching and organizing despite declining health.

title: San Francisco, Paris, and home
summary: The timeline follows his travels through the United States and Europe before his return to India.

title: A pilgrimage with his mother
summary: A pilgrimage with his mother becomes one of the final journeys highlighted by VivekMarg.

title: Four July
summary: The timeline closes with Swami Vivekananda's passing at Belur Math on July 4, 1902.
